items.question: By what count and in what locations are certain beings said to endure torment in this claim?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified for the relevant groups.
Those groups are located among thousands of womb-diagrams.
Beings in those locations are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: Whether the count applies to beings or to the diagrams remains unspecified.
items.plain_english: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are places where beings are tormented.
